name: Suzano S.A. (NYSE ADR)
verdict: FLAT — candidate-premise refuted; starter <=0.5% unlocked ONLY by named triggers (below), then re-court
adjudicated: 2026-08-22 (benches 2026-08-18; tape 7.86->8.83 fri +12.3% — NOTE: tape may be front-running the BHKP trigger; the trigger, not the tape, unlocks)
ruling: Both benches REJECT-as-outcome. The candidate's founding premises were data artifacts: (a) 'post-print new low' false — px was +4% above lo52 at bench time; (b) the '26% FCF yield' annualized one seasonal quarter of an add-back metric — the defensible number is pre-distribution ex-derivative H1 ~4.3% annualized (blue's FCF-definition ladder: adjusted 15.6% / pre-distribution 7.4% / post-everything 0.4% / ex-derivative 4.3%). Blue corrected red's method errors (PF EV/EBITDA ~5.7x not 6.4x; PF leverage ~3.5x not 3.9x; dividends-inside-FCF artifact) but sustained the conclusion: thin spoken-for cash, cost guide needing H2 -8% on its own FX assumption, US$11bn target unreachable absent pulp recovery. Blue FV $8.8 (trough-perpetual) to $14.8 (mid-cycle); Friday tape now AT the trough case.
